prereqs.name: U.S. federal holidays
prereqs.reason: Veterans Day is a federal holiday, so must understand that holiday category first.

prereqs.name: World War I history
prereqs.reason: Unrestricted submarine warfare was a German naval policy during World War I, so WWI context must come first.

prereqs.name: Central Powers
prereqs.reason: Germany conducted unrestricted submarine warfare as a member of the Central Powers against its opponents.

prereqs.name: September 11 attacks
prereqs.reason: The war was launched as a direct U.S. response to the 9/11 attacks.

prereqs.name: terrorism
prereqs.reason: The war was a counterterrorism operation against al-Qaeda and its Taliban hosts.

prereqs.name: U.S. presidency
prereqs.reason: Must understand the presidency office before understanding its term of service

prereqs.name: terrorism
prereqs.reason: The War on Terror is defined as a campaign against terrorism, so the concept must be understood first.

prereqs.name: September 11 attacks
prereqs.reason: The 9/11 attacks were the direct trigger that launched the War on Terror.

prereqs.name: War on Terror
prereqs.reason: The War in Iraq was launched as a major operation within the broader War on Terror.

prereqs.name: September 11 attacks
prereqs.reason: The 9/11 attacks triggered the War on Terror used to justify the invasion of Iraq.

prereqs.name: Persian Gulf War causes
prereqs.reason: The earlier U.S.-Iraq conflict in the Persian Gulf War provides essential background for the Iraq War.

prereqs.name: World War II
prereqs.reason: Must know the conflict itself before studying its leaders.

prereqs.name: Allied Powers
prereqs.reason: Must know one coalition whose leadership is studied.

prereqs.name: Axis Powers
prereqs.reason: Must know the opposing coalition whose leadership is studied.

prereqs.name: Voting rights
prereqs.reason: Women's suffrage is voting rights extended to women, so voting rights must be understood first.

prereqs.name: Women's rights movement
prereqs.reason: Suffrage was a central goal of the women's rights movement, which provides necessary context.

prereqs.name: executive branch
prereqs.reason: Veto is exercised by the President as head of the executive branch.

prereqs.name: legislative branch
prereqs.reason: Veto rejects bills passed by the legislative branch.

prereqs.name: checks and balances
prereqs.reason: Veto is a key check preventing one branch from dominating lawmaking.
